$comment: Single source of truth for on-device paths shared by the browser wizard (wizard/pages/js/pipeline.js) and the generated device scripts (wizard/device/*.sh). adbd's shell user is denied file creation under system_data_file even at mode 0777 (SELinux), so the page pushes into shellStaging and install.sh — already root — ingests it into incomingDir/profileList with install -m (chmod on these paths is denied even for root). Generated by pipeline/wizard/gen-pipeline-js.sh into pages/js/device-paths.js and by pipeline/wizard/render.sh into install.sh and verify.sh. Never hardcode these paths anywhere else.
